questions.q: Why must the heartbeat not be sent only from an EdgeTX widget's refresh()?
options: refresh() is called once per second
refresh() runs only while the widget is visible
questions.explain: Hide the screen and the link is gone. Call a shared tick() from both refresh() and background().

questions.q: What does serialRead() read when called without an argument?
options: The entire receive buffer at once
questions.explain: A line-based "one line, one message" protocol maps onto it naturally.

questions.q: The undefined state of the radio companion must be…
options: A reboot that waits for the radio
questions.explain: The access point comes up only after an explicit "disarmed" from the radio.

questions.q: How do you turn Wi-Fi off on an ESP32 verifiably?
questions.explain: Turning it off must be an action, not an assumption.

questions.q: What do you check before connecting the radio's UART to the ESP32?
options: Logic levels and a common GND
questions.explain: Usually 3.3 V on both sides, but checking is mandatory.

questions.q: Where must the in-flight settings write protection be?
questions.explain: Defense in depth: each side checks the arm state independently.

questions.q: Why is an onboard Wi-Fi bridge switched off in flight?
options: The module heats up inside the radio case
There is no power for it
questions.explain: For ground configuration it is fine.

questions.q: How does an ESP32 hand its own rangefinder to ArduPilot?
options: Through a PWM input on the flight controller
questions.explain: DISTANCE_SENSOR and RNGFND1_TYPE = 10 (MAVLink); the EKF and landing use the rangefinder.
